subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should this incident be handled as expected shared-DM configuration, a Telegram/session-routing delivery bug, or a new semantic runaway-output safety policy?
rationale: The evidence shows a real historical Telegram send burst and current adjacent safeguards, but the raw content and exact two-chat context are missing and current behavior still intentionally allows shared DM sessions by default.

options.title: Classify before fixing
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers decide the product boundary and request minimal redacted transcript/session evidence before any automated repair.

options.title: Treat as configuration support
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept the documented `session.dmScope` default as the expected behavior and point users to secure DM isolation setup.

options.title: Sponsor a focused fix
options.body: Pick a concrete owner boundary, such as Telegram replay throttling or session routing defaults, and require live Telegram proof for the chosen change.

recommendation.title: Classify before fixing
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers decide the product boundary and request minimal redacted transcript/session evidence before any automated repair.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is mainly a product/runtime boundary call, and the available history ties steipete to route/session docs plus adjacent loop/recovery decisions.
